advance.en: This was inspired by an earlier Polish “Bomba” machine, but was far more advanced.
advance.zh: 这灵感来源于早期波兰的“Bomba”机器，但要先进得多。

advance.en: They created a calendar system and they made significant advances in astronomy and mathematics.
advance.zh: 他们创建了历法系统，并在天文学和数学方面取得了重大进展。

advance.en: Japan had invaded British-controlled Malaya from the north and advanced down the peninsula.
advance.zh: 日本从北部入侵了英国控制的马来亚，并向半岛推进。

advance.en: So, surely a technologically advanced civilisation from prehistory would have left similar marks.
advance.zh: 所以，史前时期技术先进的文明肯定也会留下类似的痕迹。

advance.en: Could there have been a technologically advanced civilisation before us, here on Earth?
advance.zh: 在我们之前，地球上会不会曾存在过一个技术先进的文明？

adapt.en: Surely we need to know the trajectory we're heading in, in order to adapt.
adapt.zh: 毫无疑问，为了适应气候变化，我们需要了解我们正朝着哪个轨迹前进。

adapt.en: They adapted to living with humans. They evolved to fit into our social world.
adapt.zh: 它们适应了与人类共同生活。它们进化得能够融入我们的社会世界。

adapt.en: To adapt means to change so as to successfully fit in with a new situation.
adapt.zh: “Adapt”（适应）意味着改变以便成功融入新环境。

adapt.en: Whether it can adapt to the challenges of the 21st century is still an open question.
adapt.zh: 它是否能够适应21世纪的挑战仍然是一个未知数。

adapt.en: It uses the language and the techniques of Indian cuisine, but was adapted for British flavors.
adapt.zh: 它使用了印度料理的语言和技术，但为了适应英国人的口味进行了改良。

advice.en: Let’s end this episode with some advice on how to manage code switching effectively.
advice.zh: 让我们以一些关于如何有效管理语码转换的建议来结束本期节目。

advice.en: Well, here is some advice. The first step is simple… ask more questions.
advice.zh: 嗯，这里有一些建议。第一步很简单……多问问题。

advice.en: And he has begun consulting a witchdoctor for advice on matters of state.
advice.zh: 他甚至开始向巫医咨询国家大事的建议。

advice.en: What Professor Speakman doesn't have, however, is any scientific evidence for this advice.
advice.zh: 然而，Speakman教授没有的是这一建议的任何科学依据。

advice.en: It takes practice. So I want to end this episode with some advice.
advice.zh: 它需要练习。所以我想以一些建议来结束这期节目。

advise.en: He continued to advise other kings and even plotted further campaigns against Rome.
advise.zh: 他继续为其他君王出谋划策，甚至策划着进一步反抗罗马的战役。

advise.en: He advised them on how to carry themselves, how to hold a pistol, how a real lawman moved.
advise.zh: 他给演员们指点该如何举止、如何握枪、真正的执法官走路和行动是什么样子。

advise.en: For example, 'pretty much all governments advise drinking two litres a day' means 'almost all governments advise it'.
advise.zh: 例如，“几乎所有政府都建议每天喝两升”的意思就是“差不多所有政府都建议这样做”。

advise.en: For example, 'pretty much all governments advise drinking two litres a day' means 'almost all governments advise it'.
advise.zh: 例如，“几乎所有政府都建议每天喝两升”的意思就是“差不多所有政府都建议这样做”。

advise.en: Here, she advises presenter Caroline Steel on how to dress against the cold, for BBC World Service programme CrowdScience.
advise.zh: 在这里，她为 BBC World Service 节目 CrowdScience 的主持人 Caroline Steel 提供关于如何穿衣防寒的建议。

adjust.en: The process was slow as people adjusted to the new political and economic reality.
adjust.zh: 随着人们适应新的政治和经济现实，这个过程很缓慢。

adjust.en: It helps you correct mistakes, adjust your strategy, and reinforce the right patterns.
adjust.zh: 它帮助你纠正错误、调整策略并巩固正确的模式。

adjust.en: But it is also okay if your goals change or adjust slightly.
adjust.zh: 但如果你的目标发生改变或略作调整，那也是完全没问题的。

adjust.en: You adjust, try again, and improve. Now think about English learning.
adjust.zh: 你调整、再试一次、然后改进。现在想想英语学习。

adjust.en: But for many ordinary workers, wages are relatively stagnant, especially when you adjust it for inflation.
adjust.zh: 但对许多普通工人来说，工资相对停滞不前，特别是当你根据通货膨胀进行调整时。

advertise.en: Some countries launched major advertising campaigns encouraging citizens to vote for their national monument.
advertise.zh: 一些国家发起大型广告活动，鼓励公民为本国古迹投票。

advertise.en: In turn that's the content that algorithms will amplify, which ultimately means more advertising revenue.
advertise.zh: 反过来，这也是算法会放大的内容，这最终意味着更多的广告收入。

advertise.en: I also tried to emphasize how this list was basically a large advertising campaign voted on by people around the world.
advertise.zh: 我也试图强调这个名单基本上是如何变成一场由世界各地人们投票的大型广告活动的。

advertise.en: In shops and on social media, you'll find all kinds of high-protein foods being advertised, from shakes and yoghurts to chocolate.
advertise.zh: 在商店里和社交媒体上，你会发现各种高蛋白食品在做广告，从奶昔、酸奶到巧克力。

advertise.en: Lisa Lee is a toy maker based in Vancouver and the owner of Leather Monsters, a brand of leather plushies which she advertises online.
advertise.zh: Lisa Lee是一位居住在温哥华的玩具制造商，也是皮革毛绒玩具品牌Leather Monsters的创始人，她在网上宣传自己的品牌。

adopt.en: Saudi Arabia could adopt a different system that kept things in the same generation.
adopt.zh: 沙特阿拉伯可以采用一种将权力保持在同一代人手中的不同体制。

adopt.en: And it was the Egyptians who were among the first to adopt it.
adopt.zh: 埃及人是最早采用太阳历的人之一。

adopt.en: It also refers to siblings who were adopted by different parents at birth.
adopt.zh: 它也指被不同父母收养的亲兄弟姐妹。

adopt.en: Although, in this case the twins were literally separated and adopted by different parents at birth.
adopt.zh: 虽然在这个案例中，这对双胞胎确实是在出生时被不同的父母分开并收养的。

adopt.en: Protestant countries were suspicious of this decidedly Catholic reform and refused to adopt it at first.
adopt.zh: 新教国家对这种绝对是天主教的改革持怀疑态度，起初拒绝采用它。

adhere.en: I unknowingly did my best to adhere to what we call the 'man box', which is a kind of rigid set of ideals and rules that I may feel pressure as a boy to follow, in order to be a quote unquote 'real man'.
adhere.zh: 我在不知不觉中，努力去遵循我们所说的'男人框框'('man box')——那是一套僵化的理念和规则，作为一个男孩，我可能会感到有压力去遵守，才能成为所谓的'真正的男人'。

address.en: From that point on, they were no longer addressed by their names but only by their numbers.
address.zh: 从那时起，他们不再被人以姓名相称，只被叫编号。

address.en: Korea has a complicated honorific system dictating how people above you in the social order should be addressed.
address.zh: 韩国有一个复杂的尊称系统，规定了如何称呼社会秩序中地位比你高的人。

address.en: For example, multiple resolutions addressing the civil war in Syria have been blocked by vetoes from Russia and China.
address.zh: 例如，多项旨在解决叙利亚内战的决议都被俄罗斯和中国的否决票所阻挠。

address.en: To address this, the mining team would need to find some way of stabilising the asteroid, keeping it in position.
address.zh: 为了解决这个问题，采矿团队需要找到某种使小行星稳定下来、将其固定在原位的方法。

address.en: Now, to be fair to Milgram, he addressed this head-on, and he tried to figure out whether this was the case.
address.zh: 不过，公平地说，米尔格拉姆正面回应了这个问题，并试图弄清楚事实是否果真如此。

advocate.en: If you advocate something, you encourage people to use it or do it.
advocate.zh: 如果你 advocate 某事，你就是鼓励人们使用它或做它。

advocate.en: They advocate consuming extra-virgin olive oil, but as I understand it that's not suitable for frying a fish.
advocate.zh: 他们提倡食用特级初榨橄榄油，但据我所知，那并不适合炸鱼。

advocate.en: Now, Fabius Maximus had been advocating for this strategy since the early Roman defeats, but it was not a popular one with the Roman leadership.
advocate.zh: 其实，费边·马克西姆斯早在罗马遭遇早期惨败时就一直倡导这一战略，但在罗马领导层中它并不受欢迎。

additional.en: It’s a similar story with listening, although there are some additional complications and opportunities.
additional.zh: 听力的情况也类似，尽管有一些额外的复杂性和机遇。

additional.en: Now, there is one final thing to mention, and that is an additional complication to do with the unusual structure of the UK.
additional.zh: 现在，还有最后一件事要提，那就是与英国不寻常结构相关的另一个复杂情况。

additional.en: But is making new ‘mum friends’ really the positive experience it’s often described as, or an additional stress for already overworked mothers?
additional.zh: 但是，结交新的“妈妈朋友”真的像人们常说的那样是一段积极的经历，还是给本来就工作过度的母亲们增添了额外的压力？

additional.en: His bombing campaign had started in 1978, and had continued, off and on, until 1995, killing 3 people and injuring an additional 23.
additional.zh: 他的炸弹袭击始于 1978 年，断断续续一直持续到 1995 年，造成 3 人死亡，23 人受伤。

adjacent.en: The learner was then taken to an adjacent room and, as the teacher watched, strapped into a chair.
adjacent.zh: 接着，“学生”被带到隔壁房间，在“教师”的注视下被绑到椅子上。

adore.en: But this one did. By all accounts, George adored her, and was faithful to her for their 57-year union.
adore.zh: 但这桩婚姻却很美满。据各方记载，George 深爱着她，并在长达 57 年的婚姻中对她忠贞不渝。

administration.en: I had to pay a very small administration fee, and I got it back.
administration.zh: 我不得不支付了一笔很小的行政管理费，然后把它拿了回来。

administration.en: Writing was used for religion and trade and administration, and even history.
administration.zh: 文字被用于宗教、贸易、行政管理甚至是历史记录。

administration.en: The government invested in infrastructure, education, housing, healthcare, and public administration.
administration.zh: 政府投资于基础设施、教育、住房、医疗保健和公共行政。

administration.en: Leaders, laws and systems appear. They form governments and administration.
administration.zh: 领导者、法律和体制随之出现。他们组成了政府和行政机构。

administration.en: Writing most likely came from administration and accounting.
administration.zh: 文字最有可能源于行政管理和会计。

adoption.en: New models are coming out almost every week, adoption is increasing fast, and AI is being deployed into everything we do.
adoption.zh: 几乎每周都有新模型问世，普及速度正在加快，AI 正在被部署到我们所做的每一件事中。

addition.en: And then there’s an even more modern addition: what researchers call subjective well-being.
addition.zh: 此外还有一个更现代的补充：研究人员所称的主观幸福感（subjective well-being）。

addition.en: While most children were learning simple addition and multiplication, Ramanujan was already exploring complex ideas entirely on his own.
addition.zh: 当大多数孩子还在学习简单的加法和乘法时，Ramanujan就已经完全靠自己探索复杂的思想了。

addition.en: In fact, in addition to Christmas Island, they also used Nauru, which is a tiny country in the Pacific Ocean, which held asylum seekers to prevent them entering Australia and also Manus Island in Papua New Guinea.
addition.zh: 事实上，除了圣诞岛，他们还使用了瑙鲁，这是太平洋上的一个小国，关押寻求庇护者以防止他们进入澳大利亚，还有巴布亚新几内亚的马努斯岛。

admiration.en: He had been outspoken in his admiration for Mao Zedong, and had flirted with ideas from the Chinese Revolution.
admiration.zh: 他曾公开表达对毛泽东的崇拜，并对中国革命的思想产生过兴趣。

admission.en: But now think about a university admissions officer.
admission.zh: 但现在想想大学招生官。

admission.en: By his own admission, he was a street kid, living on the streets, learning how to fight and stand up for himself.
admission.zh: 据他自己承认，他是个街头混混，混迹街头，学会了如何打架和保护自己。

admission.en: In fact, studies show that university admissions teams and job recruiters are often poor at predicting long-term performance.
admission.zh: 事实上，研究表明，大学招生团队和招聘人员往往很难预测长期的表现。

admission.en: The IELTS exam or the International English Language Testing System is also widely used for university admissions and immigration in places like the UK, Australia, Canada, and New Zealand.
admission.zh: 雅思考试也广泛用于英国、澳大利亚、加拿大和新西兰等地的大学招生和移民。
